## Claims
- [source-backed] The supplied source-29 full text states Lemma 2.5’s implication from a nonzero homogeneous syzygy to consistency of the decomposable equations, and defines tall right-hand sides as \(f_{\nu_B}\) and wide ones as \(0\). [doi:10.1112/jlms.12832, lines 176-189]
- [source-backed] The supplied text states Theorem 4.4’s inconsistency conclusion and Theorem 4.5 derives absence of the specified syzygy from Lemma 2.5 and Theorem 4.4. [doi:10.1112/jlms.12832, lines 473-502]
- [unsupported] The required complete formulas for equations (8)–(10) and all Definition 2.1 valid-tuple inequalities are not recoverable from the supplied source-29 passage: its equation displays and the inequalities following “with” are corrupted/truncated. [doi:10.1112/jlms.12832, lines 149-188]
- [unsupported] No supplied alternate-provider FULL-TEXT SOURCE supplies an uncorrupted bounded replacement excerpt containing all requested items.
- [unsupported] The requested target—one uncorrupted bounded full-text excerpt containing (8)–(10), complete Definition 2.1 inequalities, and the Lemma 2.5/Theorems 4.4–4.5 linkage—is **not established**.

## Strategy
Compare the supplied ar5iv full-text block with alternate search records. Retain only legible theorem linkage; do not reconstruct truncated formulas.

## Gaps
The only supplied 2024 full-text block is corrupt precisely at equations (8)–(10) and Definition 2.1. Crossref/arXiv candidate records do not provide an alternate uncorrupted full-text passage.

## Next
Obtain a bounded full-text passage from a different provider or the publisher PDF/text, then transcribe the missing equations and all valid-tuple inequalities verbatim.
